scope: Typed offscreen operation descriptors remove impossible clip/error wrappers and unused geometry fields; coordinate localization fixes integer edge/origin overflow. Recording command dummy fields remain separate audit work.

clippy_warnings.transient_compile_result: A documented large-enum expectation keeps this temporary return value on the stack instead of allocating once per offscreen layer.

cards.clip_lowering: Integer rectangle path inputs use normal SDF rectangle recognition; permanent regressions separately cover actual path clips.

spirv.resource_abi_validation: actual DXC output validated by build/native.rs

dxil.resource_abi_validation: actual DXC output validated by build/native.rs

platform_limit: macOS Metal GPU execution and real DXC DXIL/SPIR-V artifact validation; Windows DX12/Vulkan GPU execution not performed.
resolution: OffscreenLayer has no clip variant and only geometry groups own a draw. Compiler classification is exhaustive; LayerError/native unwrapping, dummy execution-plan draws, unused clip localization and impossible capacity cases are removed.
Retained patching uses the actual compiled variant; kind changes recompile. Parameter changes preserve batch topology.
Signed-coordinate bounds saturate during localization instead of wrapping; path origins cast to float before negation. Both bugs have red unit evidence and actual Metal disappearing-content evidence.
Five new semantic/regression tests replace one invalid-plan test. Fractional path edges and explicit path-record counts ensure actual path and SDF routes are distinct.
Windows all-target checks exposed cumsum assertion type inference ambiguity. Explicit byte casts preserve semantic checks on Metal, DX12 and Vulkan.
Final application executables exactly match the timed SHA-256 hashes. No stable material application timing regression is identified; no isolated speedup is claimed.
